classification.classification_reason: The article discusses the launch of an electric cruise service on the Yamuna River in Delhi, which is a significant technological and environmental initiative.

content.title: Delhi’s First Electric Cruise Service Launched
content.caption: Delhi’s first electric cruise service was inaugurated on Yamuna at Sonia Vihar.

slides.heading: Delhi’s First Electric Cruise Service
slides.text: Delhi launches first electric cruise service on Yamuna River.
slides.image_search_query: Delhi electric cruise service Yamuna River India

slides.heading: What Happened?
slides.text: Union Minister for Ports, Shipping and Waterways Sarbananda Sonowal inaugurated the Namo Yamuna River Cruise Service on Yamuna at Sonia Vihar.
slides.image_search_query: Namo Yamuna River Cruise Service India

slides.heading: Why Does It Matter?
slides.text: The service introduces an electric cruise with a capacity of 30 passengers, with a second cruise scheduled for February-March 2027.
